legacy_flow.readings: Current, matching STREAM readings are unavailable or not time-coherent. Flow evaluation stopped, including when inverted.
legacy_flow.arguments: Use a supported comparison direction and a finite threshold in the card range.
legacy_flow.forecast: A recent forecast for the correct Homey-local date and current location/settings is unavailable. Flow evaluation stopped.

coordination.source_limits: Choose separate grid, battery SOC and battery-power readings; inverter output is not battery power. W/kW conversion does not verify direction or circuit scope. Upstream apps may estimate values or substitute zero for missing data. A recent capability timestamp is not a verified sensor heartbeat; unchanged values may expire. Never select a different reading just to bypass a blocked source.
coordination.display_only: Display only — not eligible for Flow monitoring
coordination.reader_lifetime: Stopping closes this app's reader and discards its token reference. It does not revoke Homey's broad API permission or the platform API session. Use Homey's permission/app management for platform access; no automatic credential revocation is attempted.
coordination.flow_not_checked: Flow session status has not been checked. Opening this page never starts monitoring. Use Check status or Stop if a session may already be running.
coordination.flow_unverified_source: Dual CT candidate-preview sources remain display-only and cannot be used by these Flow observations yet. Choose a reviewed P1, original meter or another suitable source.
coordination.flow_condition_error: Coordination readings or setup are unavailable. Check the opt-in session, source timestamps, scope and card arguments. Evaluation stopped; no charging permission is implied.
coordination.flow_help: Separate from the page preview. Start a 30-minute observation session reading only the selected devices, roughly every 15 seconds. It continues if this page closes, but stops at expiry or app restart. WHEN cards may run your existing THEN actions. Review those Flows first. These observations are not verified charging permission or proof of solar origin. No device commands or Energy changes are made.
coordination.flow_consent: I explicitly allow this temporary background observation session and understand that its triggers may run my Flows.
coordination.flow_stop_soc: External-battery priority stop threshold (%) — lower than start
coordination.flow_off: Flow observation is off. Nothing starts automatically.
coordination.flow_running: Last checked: Flow observation was active, for up to 30 minutes from Start. Closing the page does not stop it. Check status again when needed, or use Stop to revoke it.
coordination.flow_failed: Could not confirm the Flow session. Check its status or use Stop before retrying.
coordination.flow_stop_unconfirmed: Stop was not confirmed. Retry Stop or restart the app; the session also expires within 30 minutes.
coordination.permission: Homey's cross-app API permission is broad. This preview restricts its implementation to listing metadata and reading selected capabilities; it exposes no control or arbitrary API route.
coordination.title: Read-only battery coordination preview
coordination.overview: Review grid and battery readings. This preview never controls devices or contributes to Energy.
coordination.consent: Allow this page to list suitable Homey capabilities and read my selected sources.
coordination.privacy: Names stay in this local picker. No telemetry or selections are added to support reports. No polling or automatic exports.
coordination.site: Installation label (letters, digits, hyphens; no private IDs)
coordination.polarity: A positive value in the source app means…
coordination.reviewed: I reviewed units, direction and scope. Both external-battery readings describe the same battery. The grid source covers this whole installation.
coordination.noCompetingController: I reviewed native modes/schedules; no competing controller.
coordination.otherSourcesReviewed: I reviewed other batteries/generators that could cause export.
coordination.timing: Update time is not proof of fresh hardware measurement. Old/unknown timestamps block advice. Hybrid output mixes solar and battery; a load is only one branch.
coordination.state_review_candidate: Surplus to review — not permission to charge
coordination.disabledActions: Controls, Flow actions and Dual CT Energy remain disabled.
coordination.expired: Readings expired. Request another snapshot when convenient; nothing was refreshed automatically.
coordination.enabled: Opted in for this page only. Choose sources to begin.
coordination.changed: Selection changed. Earlier advice and waiting time cleared.
coordination.loaded: Choose sources and original directions. Values are read only on request.
coordination.empty: No suitable numeric W, kW or % capabilities found, or session unavailable.
coordination.snapshot: Selected-source snapshot. No device settings changed.
coordination.saved: Selections saved. Opt-in and confirmations are not restored automatically.
coordination.failed: Read failed or timed out. No commands sent. Reopen source session to retry.
coordination.busy: Another read is finishing. Please wait.
coordination.invalid: Complete valid source/unit/direction selections and review their scope.
coordination.contract: Device, capability or unit changed. Review selection.
coordination.timestamp: No usable source timestamp. Request time cannot replace it.
coordination.skew: Source timestamps are too far apart.
coordination.ownership: Review overrides, native controllers and other sources.
coordination.priority: External battery still has charging priority.
coordination.flows: Battery discharge or cross-charging detected. Advice blocked.
coordination.importing: Grid import present; no surplus charging suggested.
coordination.noSurplus: Insufficient observed export. Branch/battery watts are not added to invent surplus.
coordination.dwell: Waiting for sustained fresh surplus and cooldown. Source timestamps must advance.
coordination.candidate: Observed export qualifies for review only. Solar origin and safe charging are unverified.
coordination.unchanged: Power timestamps unchanged. Cache reads cannot advance the waiting period.
coordination.reason_unknown: Insufficient information. Review bindings and timestamps.

dual_ct_preview.name: Smart Meter Dual CT preview
dual_ct_preview.pair_warning: Read-only preview, not verified measurements. CT1/CT2 labels and V/A/W follow community comparisons with the EcoFlow app, not an official verified contract. Grid/Solar roles, direction and phase order remain unverified. Totals and counters remain raw candidates. Ages are since receipt, not measurement time; fields need not be simultaneous. Do not use for decisions or automation. No Homey Energy, control commands, Flow cards, tags or Insights are enabled. Circuit descriptions are user settings, not verified mappings. Phase 1/2/3 are candidate positions, not confirmed wiring labels. New phase sums use one packet only and are not Energy sources; reported totals and counters remain raw.
dual_ct_preview.pair_privacy: This is continuous read-only monitoring, not a two-minute diagnostic capture. It uses the shared EcoFlow app connection and may affect an EcoFlow app session. Latest candidate values appear on Homey, which may retain capability values until cleared; there is no raw-packet archive or numeric support export. Existing app-account credentials are reused, or stored in Homey app settings only when you add a device. Nothing is sent to the developer. Disable preview in device settings to detach its listener and clear its displays.
dual_ct_preview.pair_consentLabel: I understand the limits and consent to continuous read-only candidate monitoring for the device I add.
dual_ct_preview.consent_required: Explicit preview consent is required. Add the preview through its pairing screen.
dual_ct_preview.account_required: Sign in with your EcoFlow app account to discover owned Dual CT devices.
dual_ct_preview.discovery_failed: Could not verify an owned model-421 Dual CT device for this account.
dual_ct_preview.login_failed: Could not sign in. Check your EcoFlow account and region.
dual_ct_preview.warning: CT1/CT2 and V/A/W: community-observed mapping, not a verified contract. Grid/Solar roles, direction and phase order unverified. Totals/counters remain raw. Ages since receipt; fields not necessarily simultaneous. No Energy or controls; do not use for automation. Circuit descriptions are user settings, not verified mappings. Phase 1/2/3 are candidate positions, not confirmed wiring labels. New phase sums use one packet only and are not Energy sources; reported totals and counters remain raw.
dual_ct_preview.counter_warning: Raw counters: units, period and circuit unconfirmed; ages since receipt
dual_ct_preview.sum_same_packet: Signed sum of 3 phases in one packet; receipt age, not measurement time; unverified
dual_ct_preview.sum_partial: Sum unavailable: latest power packet is incomplete
dual_ct_preview.sum_mismatch: Sum unavailable: reported total disagrees with phases
dual_ct_preview.account_changed: Account changed. Old readings cleared. Disable and re-enable preview to recheck its original account; another account requires re-pairing this preview only.
dual_ct_preview.model_unavailable: The owned model-421 Dual CT device could not be verified. Preview stopped.
dual_ct_preview.connection_failed: Preview connection unavailable. Retrying with bounded backoff; no commands are sent.
dual_ct_preview.display_failed: Preview display update failed. Do not rely on retained values.
dual_ct_preview.waiting_stale: No recent accepted candidates. Missing or stale is not zero.
dual_ct_preview.missing_stale: Not observed or stale — no zero assumed

dual_ct.working_assumptions: Working assumptions for this read-only preview, not verified device mappings. Raw signs are unchanged. Bank letters do not identify physical CT ports. Your observations do not enable accounting or controls.
dual_ct.working_grid: Working assumption: EcoFlow Grid. Direction and phase order still need validation.
dual_ct.working_conflict: Your observation conflicts with this working assumption. No mapping or sign change has been applied.
dual_ct.working_solar: Working assumption: EcoFlow Solar / inverter circuit. This may include battery discharge, not just PV generation. Direction still needs validation.
dual_ct.working_counter_warning: Candidate Grid energy: raw record 773 divided by 1,000, assuming Wh to kWh. Scale and roles remain unverified. Not a verified daily total; period/reset origin unknown. Signed net values can decrease. No Homey Energy accounting.
dual_ct.continuity_not_updated: No counter update in latest packet; last record keeps its own age
dual_ct.continuity_no_record: No counter record observed; recent packets do not make a counter available
dual_ct.readiness_device_blocked: Verified meter capabilities remain blocked: bank roles, units, direction and physical comparisons still need validation. The separate opt-in Dual CT preview driver displays raw candidates only, without Energy or controls.
dual_ct.readiness_energy_blocked: Homey Energy adoption is blocked. Counter period/reset behaviour, one authoritative source and upgrade/rollback acceptance remain unverified.
dual_ct.continuity_warning: Receipt-time observations within this capture only. A decrease is not proof of a reset; a signed net counter can decrease normally. Packets without a counter do not refresh it. Invalid/partial records and gaps still break comparisons. No background or overnight recording.
dual_ct.continuity_daily_unavailable: Daily totals unavailable: counter units/period and a day-start baseline are not verified. Cumulative origin is unknown. Restart clears this observation history.
dual_ct.continuity_not_reported: No continuity observations retained. Use the optional counter preview in a future capture if needed.
dual_ct.counter_opt_in: Also inspect unscaled counter candidates in the next capture (optional; requires numeric preview). Record 997 stays structure-only. No accounting changes.
dual_ct.comparison_include: Use one combined comparison export, including counter candidates if captured and my local bank observations. Sharing still requires consent below.
dual_ct.comparison_warning: Historical, unverified candidates—not current meter readings. W/V/A and phase order are hypotheses. Ages are since receipt, not measurement. Missing is not zero. Grid/Solar selections are your observations, not confirmed mappings. Local only; no Energy, Flows or controls.
dual_ct.comparison_looks_like_grid: Looks like the EcoFlow Grid view
dual_ct.comparison_looks_like_solar: Looks like the EcoFlow Solar view
dual_ct.counter_warning: Numbers are raw, unscaled candidates with unknown units and period. Do not assume Wh, kWh, today or lifetime. Arithmetic checks compare fields in one record only. Nothing is added to Homey Energy.
dual_ct.counter_structure_only: Counter numbers were not enabled for this capture; structure only.
dual_ct.counter_missing: No supported nested records retained. Missing is not zero.
dual_ct.counter_invalid: Record rejected for research; no numbers used
dual_ct.counter_oversized: Record exceeds the research limit; no numbers used
dual_ct.counter_997_structure: Record 997: structure only; no independent numeric mapping confirmed.
dual_ct.title: Dual CT research — opt-in, read-only
dual_ct.overview: Two-minute read-only discovery using saved accounts. By default it records structure only. Optional local numeric candidates require a separate opt-in; sharing those candidates requires additional consent. Energy, Flows and commands remain disabled. The shared connection may affect an EcoFlow app session.
dual_ct.workflow_idle: For a requested numeric report, select local numeric candidates before Start. Nothing is collected or shared automatically.
dual_ct.workflow_numeric_running: Numeric capture is running. Leave this page open; it will refresh the local result once after the two-minute window. Do not press Stop at the end: Stop clears captured readings. Nothing is shared automatically.
dual_ct.workflow_numeric_manual: The automatic local refresh has run, but capture is still reported as active. Use Refresh local summary and preview when convenient. No automatic retry or new capture will run.
dual_ct.workflow_structure_running: Structure-only capture is running. This mode does not collect readings for numeric export.
dual_ct.workflow_complete: Capture finished. Review the retained readings below, allow numeric sharing, then download the numeric comparison JSON. No new capture is needed. The original 15-minute retention limit still applies.
dual_ct.compact_help: This compact report is not the numeric comparison export. valuesCaptured: true means readings were collected locally; valuesIncluded: false means this diagnostic report intentionally excludes them. Use the numeric export above for captured readings. encodingVerified: false is a research safeguard, not a download failure.
dual_ct.numeric_combined_identity: Numeric comparison export: ecoflow-dual-ct-comparison.json (dual_ct_comparison). Includes retained candidate readings and any captured counter candidates; not verified measurements. Sharing requires your consent below.
dual_ct.numeric_scalar_identity: Numeric candidates export: ecoflow-dual-ct-candidates.json. Includes retained candidate readings only; not the compact diagnostic report or verified measurements.
dual_ct.cleanup_warning: A listener cleanup failed. Capture callbacks have been disabled, but review the integration report before repeating the test.
dual_ct.capture_mode_numeric: Capture mode: structure and optional local numeric candidates. Normal reports exclude readings.
dual_ct.capture_mode_structure: Capture mode: structure only; numeric preview is off.
dual_ct.capture_mode_unknown: The capture's numeric-preview setting is not reported. Refresh to check it; the checkbox is not proof of the active mode.
dual_ct.capture_mode_locked: The running capture's mode is locked. To change it, press Stop, choose the option and press Start; nothing restarts automatically.
dual_ct.capture_mode_mismatch: Start reused the existing capture, not the newly requested preview setting. Stop first to change its mode.
dual_ct.capture_help: For numeric captures, keep this page open for one automatic local refresh after two minutes. Then review and export below; do not press Stop. If you return later, use Refresh local summary and preview. Refresh does not extend the 15-minute retention window. No timed screenshots are required.
dual_ct.preview_opt_in: Include local numeric candidates in the next capture (optional; excluded from normal support reports). Stop first if a capture is already running.
dual_ct.preview_warning: Unverified numeric candidates, not confirmed Dual CT readings. Legacy-overlap units are suggestions; additional scalar units and all CT/phase roles and direction are unknown. An omitted encoding marker is a candidate zero/default interpretation, not verified plaintext. Age is time since receipt, not measurement age. Do not use for decisions or automations. Each live field expires after 90 seconds; the separate historical snapshot has its own 15-minute retention window. Nothing is shared automatically; no Energy, Flows or controls.
dual_ct.bank_recent: received less than 90 seconds ago; not a measurement timestamp
dual_ct.bank_summary_help: Numeric-free capture summary: latest and last-complete arithmetic outcomes are separate. Ages are at the last refresh. Bank A/B are not verified Grid/Solar roles. Receipt age does not prove simultaneous measurement.
dual_ct.bank_warning: Historical same-payload arithmetic checks only. Bank A/B and phase labels are hypotheses, NOT CT1/CT2, grid or solar roles. Packet indices identify decoded payloads, not measurement timestamps. Matching sums do not verify units, direction, phase ordering or simultaneous measurement. No Energy, Flows or controls.
dual_ct.preview_basis_not_reported: not reported in this older preview
dual_ct.preview_omitted_encoding_rejected: The encoding marker was omitted, but the stricter candidate payload checks did not pass. No numeric values were retained; do not repeat the capture unless a specific follow-up is needed.
dual_ct.metadata_trimmed: Inventory candidate details were shortened for the compact report. Structure coverage refers to retained capture shapes, not every field ever sent. Separate additional-field diagnostics may include fields from later packets.
dual_ct.preview_disabled: Numeric preview is off. Enable the optional local candidates checkbox before starting a new capture.
dual_ct.preview_ready: Numeric candidates were accepted for the local preview below; units, direction and channel roles remain unverified.
dual_ct.preview_not_reported: Preview details were not included in this report. Its absence does not prove opt-in was disabled.
dual_ct.preview_no_samples: No eligible live measurement samples have reached the preview yet. Refresh during the capture window.
dual_ct.preview_no_eligible_meter: No eligible owned Dual CT meter was identified for this capture.
dual_ct.preview_capture_unavailable: Capture could not discover or listen to this meter. Check the local summary for account/transport status; no candidates are available.
dual_ct.preview_missing_encoding: The encoding marker was omitted. No usable candidates are available from this snapshot. Omission alone is not proof of plaintext; check the compact report's attempt/accept counts.
dual_ct.preview_unsupported_encoding: A measurement packet has an unsupported encoding marker. Numeric decoding is blocked.
dual_ct.preview_invalid_header: A measurement packet has an invalid or ambiguous header. It was not used for numeric preview.
dual_ct.preview_model_unverified: Telemetry arrived, but app productType 421 is not corroborated for this meter. Numeric decoding remains blocked.
dual_ct.preview_no_supported_candidates: A plaintext packet arrived, but it contained no accepted candidate values. Missing, malformed and unsupported fields are not replaced with zero.
dual_ct.preview_expired: Live candidate values have expired; expired does not mean zero. A retained diagnostic snapshot may still be available below. Do not repeat the capture just to export it.
dual_ct.preview_stopped: Capture stopped. Local numeric candidates were cleared.
dual_ct.preview_account_changed: Account settings changed. Previous numeric candidates were cleared.
dual_ct.preview_request_failed: The local preview request failed or timed out. Refresh when convenient; no candidate export is available from this request.
dual_ct.candidate_consent: Allow this separate export to include the retained historical numeric candidates. Review the JSON before copying or downloading.
dual_ct.export_not_loaded: Numeric export is unavailable until a retained snapshot has loaded. Use Refresh local summary and preview to check the existing capture; choosing combined format does not capture readings.
dual_ct.export_refreshing: Checking the existing capture. Both export options are temporarily unavailable while the snapshot loads; no new capture is started.
dual_ct.export_starting: Discovery is starting. Export options become available only if numeric candidates are accepted and retained.
dual_ct.export_ready: Historical numeric snapshot available. You can choose the combined format and explicitly allow numeric sharing. Nothing is sent automatically.
dual_ct.export_scalar_only: Historical scalar candidates are available for optional sharing, but a valid combined comparison is not available. The combined-format option is disabled; scalar export is still available with your consent.
dual_ct.export_numeric_disabled: This capture has numeric preview turned off, so there are no numeric candidates to export. The export checkbox cannot change an existing capture's mode. Choose numeric capture before a future requested capture; do not repeat it just for this message.
dual_ct.export_no_samples: No accepted numeric samples are retained yet. Refresh the local summary when convenient to check this capture. A received packet alone does not guarantee usable readings.
dual_ct.export_no_eligible_meter: No eligible Dual CT meter was identified for this capture. Numeric sharing and combined export are unavailable; this is not a zero reading.
dual_ct.export_decode_blocked: No exportable numeric snapshot is available because candidate checks did not accept the received data. The preview and compact summary explain the capture state; no full support report is needed just to enable this checkbox.
dual_ct.export_capture_missing: A snapshot could not be associated with a valid capture ID. Numeric sharing is blocked to avoid exporting the wrong capture. Refresh the local summary; do not start another capture just to check this.
dual_ct.export_snapshot_invalid: The retained snapshot could not be validated for sharing. Both export options are disabled rather than exporting incomplete or inconsistent data. Refresh the local summary to check it.
dual_ct.export_no_snapshot: No exportable historical numeric snapshot was returned. Refresh the local summary to check the existing capture; selecting combined format cannot recover missing data.
dual_ct.export_expired: The fixed 15-minute retention window has ended and the numeric snapshot was cleared. Both export options are disabled. Refreshing does not extend retention; no repeat capture is requested.
dual_ct.export_stopped: Discovery was stopped and its retained numeric data was cleared. Both export options are disabled; a combined format cannot restore cleared readings.
dual_ct.export_account_changed: Account settings changed, so the previous numeric snapshot and sharing consent were cleared. Both export options are disabled until a snapshot for the current account is available.
dual_ct.export_capture_unavailable: The current capture could not be discovered or read. Both export options are unavailable. Check the local capture summary; this does not mean the meter reads zero.
dual_ct.export_request_failed: The local snapshot request failed or timed out. No numeric export is available from this request. Try Refresh local summary when convenient; a new capture or full support report is not needed just to check.
dual_ct.export_clock_changed: The clock moved backwards, so the displayed snapshot and consent were cleared. Refresh the local summary to recheck the existing capture; no old readings will be exported.
dual_ct.candidate_help: Historical capture evidence, NOT live readings or verified measurements. Opt-in retains up to 20 fields per meter locally for 15 minutes from the first accepted packet; refreshing does not extend this. Fields may come from different packets. Export includes receipt ages and unverified units/encoding, but no device names, serials, account details or raw packets. Stop, a new capture, account change or app restart clears retained evidence; leaving settings clears the displayed copy and consent. Nothing is sent automatically. Normal support reports remain structure-only; coverage counts flag trimming.
dual_ct.candidate_snapshot_ready: Historical diagnostic snapshot available for optional export within the fixed 15-minute retention window. It is separate from the live preview and is not current meter data.
dual_ct.candidate_snapshot_expired: The historical diagnostic snapshot's retention window ended and it was cleared. No export is available; do not repeat the capture unless a specific follow-up is requested.
dual_ct.candidate_copied: Candidate JSON copied. Send it privately only if you choose to share these readings.
dual_ct.candidate_copy_fallback: Copy or download is unavailable here. Select the candidate JSON shown on this page and copy it manually; nothing has been sent.
dual_ct.candidate_download_requested: Numeric JSON download requested. Check your saved files; if your mobile webview does not save it, copy the candidate JSON shown on this page manually.
dual_ct.structure_partial: Compact report retains representative structure, not every field. Included/available unique fields:
dual_ct.stage_subscribed_no_samples: Subscribed, but no recognised structure received yet.
dual_ct.stage_received_unmapped: A response was received, but no verified mapping is available.
dual_ct.stage_identified_no_transport: Meter identified, but no active transport is available. See route results below.
dual_ct.stage_structure_captured: Telemetry structure captured; measurement meanings remain unverified.
dual_ct.preview_unavailable: Candidate preview: Not available. Refresh the local preview for its current state. Units and channel roles remain unverified; Energy, Flows and controls remain disabled.
dual_ct.copied: Compact report copied. Review it before sending privately.
dual_ct.copy_fallback: Copy or download is unavailable here. Select the compact report text below and copy it manually.
dual_ct.download_requested: Download requested. Check your saved files; some mobile webviews do not save downloads. The compact text below is the fallback.
dual_ct.not_started: Dual CT capture has not been started.
dual_ct.listening: The capture window is open. A subscription alone does not prove that telemetry has arrived.
dual_ct.stopped: Capture stopped; the retained evidence is available locally.
dual_ct.sample_limit: Capture reached its sample limit and stopped.
dual_ct.account_changed: Account or connection settings changed; prior capture evidence was cleared.
dual_ct.no_explicit_model: No explicitly identified Dual CT model was found. This does not prove the meter is absent.
dual_ct.transport_unavailable: No listening transport was available for this capture.
dual_ct.discovery_unavailable: Account discovery was unavailable. Check the saved app/Developer account configuration.
dual_ct.timeout: Request timed out. Capture may still be running; use Stop or refresh the local summary.
dual_ct.error: Could not read capture status. Refresh the local summary; do not delete or re-pair devices.
dual_ct.route_received: receipt confirmed in this capture (not proof of a current connection or valid measurements)
dual_ct.observed_help: Telemetry structure was observed. Channel mapping, units and direction are still unverified; no values feed Energy or Flows.
dual_ct.no_data_help: No interpretable telemetry structure is recorded yet. Missing, empty or unrecognised data is inconclusive, not a zero reading.
dual_ct.snapshot_help: This is a local snapshot, not a live connection indicator. Refresh does not contact EcoFlow or start another capture. The integration JSON contains the bounded anonymous observation timeline.

reporter.capture_guide_refresh: Refresh the integration report. Check the installed app version and UTC capture time above; an old displayed report is not a new capture.
reporter.capture_guide_screenshots: If investigating a visible mismatch, include the relevant EcoFlow and Homey screens when convenient. Note the time/timezone and any gap between captures. There is no one-minute deadline; live comparisons you have already made are useful evidence.
reporter.capture_guide_json: Download the integration JSON from this displayed report when convenient. Send the JSON file rather than only a screenshot or log ID. No repeated or rushed capture is required unless a specific new question needs it.
reporter.capture_guide_log: If an app log is needed for a specific issue, create a diagnostic report from Homey's EcoFlow app page when convenient and send its log ID. The log ID and integration JSON are different items. Note the issue and capture time; they do not have to be sent together.
reporter.capture_guide_privacy: Review screenshots and files before sharing, preferably by direct message. Never send API keys, passwords or tokens. Nothing is uploaded automatically; no device deletion, re-pairing or mode change is required for this capture.
reporter.title: Battery reporter readiness
reporter.refresh: Show the integration report to check readiness.
reporter.none: No existing original Home Battery is paired.
reporter.ready: Ready for the optional monitoring trial
reporter.rollback: Waiting for original readings after rollback
reporter.lookup: Reporter check missing, expired or unchanged
reporter.failed: Evidence unavailable or a write failed
reporter.check: Run Check current battery reporter, then show the report again.
reporter.pair: Keep the paired STREAM 5000 Unit monitor. If missing, add that monitor, not another Home Battery. Do not delete existing devices.
reporter.review: Review duplicate monitors or Home Batteries for the same installation before enabling. Send the report if unsure.
reporter.wait: Wait for fresh readings and refresh the report. If this persists, send the JSON and a separate app-log ID.
reporter.capture: Send this JSON and matching EcoFlow screenshots privately. Do not delete or re-pair devices.
reporter.enable: Optional: enable the monitoring trial in this existing Home Battery's Advanced Settings. Battery controls will be disabled.
reporter.scope: Trial: selected system percentage, watts and charging state only. Original energy/history scope remains unverified. Battery level, battery health and charge limit are different values.
reporter.snapshot: Snapshot only; refresh to see changes. Turning the trial off restores the original source without re-pairing.
reporter.parts_title: Download not working? Send the report in parts
reporter.parts_help: Prefer the JSON file. If this phone blocks downloads, send every numbered part in a separate private message. Copy the whole part, including its header and backticks. The encoded text preserves the JSON against forum formatting; it is not encrypted. Do not edit it or mix captures. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
reporter.parts_manual: Clipboard unavailable. The complete part is selected: copy it manually.
reporter.downloaded: Download requested. If no file appears, use the report parts below. Review before sharing privately; this is separate from Homey’s app-log ID.
reporter.download_failed: Download unavailable here. Use the report parts below or copy the full report into a .txt file.
reporter.activation_only: Activation eligibility applies before enabling. An active trial is not awaiting activation.
reporter.update_pending: New readings are waiting to be applied. The last complete, fresh snapshot remains online; Flow conditions wait for matching current values.
reporter.linked_unit_power: Linked 5000 Unit: individual battery power and direction are not verified. Blank unit tiles do not mean zero power or a lost connection. Home Battery shows combined readings.
reporter.request_timeout: The report request timed out. Try again, or use Show integration support report for a local-only report. No automatic retry is made; an earlier reporter check may still be finishing.
reporter.capture_scope: All displayed states, receipt ages and freshness flags describe the capture time, not the current connection. Refresh manually for new data. Download saves this same snapshot.
reporter.grid_scope: Positive means import; negative means export. These are separate reported sources, not interchangeable installation totals. Close receipt times do not prove matching device sampling times. The difference is not verified loss. No change to energy accounting.
reporter.unit_scope: Unit battery readings describe this physical device. House and grid readings describe the system and are not individual battery power. Blank unit flow/state means unverified, not zero. Grid meter and flow-derived import/export are separate sources. Use Home Battery for combined Energy.
reporter.original_unit_scope: Unit grid connection port shows gridConnectionPower, not battery flow or whole-house grid power. Unit battery flow/state use fresh BMS charge/discharge DC pack watts when both arrive together. DC pack watts can differ from EcoFlow’s AC/system flow. Missing or stale BMS packets leave these tiles blank; they do not mean zero or disconnection. Remaining time is shown only for the fresh matching battery direction.
reporter.application_failed: EcoFlow data arrived, but Homey could not apply one or more readings. Their freshness is not renewed; see readingFreshness in the integration JSON.
reporter.individual_flow_unverified: Individual battery flow/direction is unverified. Blank does not mean zero or a connection failure.
reporter.reading_expired: One or more readings expired; unrelated updates cannot refresh old watts.
reporter.reading_not_reported: This source has not supplied a usable reading for one or more tiles.
reporter.trial_sources: Combined percentage, battery watts and state use the selected 5000 reporter. Other system-flow tiles are suppressed; energy counters retain the original address.
reporter.counter_scope: Counter continuity is diagnostic only. Combined-installation scope is unverified; no accounting source is changed.
reporter.counter_possible_stall: A recently received counter is unchanged for at least five minutes while matching-direction power is currently observed. This is a possible mismatch, not proof of a stalled counter.
reporter.counter_incomplete: One or more original counters are missing, invalid or stale. No automatic fallback or migration is performed.

monitoring_trial.help: Mixed-generation reading trial: after a fresh reporter check, opt in from the existing STREAM Home Battery's Advanced Settings. Keep its paired 5000 Unit monitor; do not add another Home Battery. Only combined SOC, battery power and charging state change. Cumulative energy/history retain their original source and unverified combined scope. Unsupported installation flow tiles clear and battery controls are disabled. The trial checks identity every four minutes and uses cached paired telemetry. Turn the setting off to roll back without re-pairing.
monitoring_trial.warning: Monitoring trial: system SOC and derived battery power use the paired 5000 reporter. Cumulative energy and history still use the original source; their combined-system scope is unverified. Controls are disabled. Turn off the trial to restore original readings.
monitoring_trial.unavailable: Monitoring reporter missing, stale or changed. No fallback to original zeros. Check the integration report or turn off the monitoring trial.
monitoring_trial.blocked: Battery controls are disabled during the monitoring reporter trial. No control migration has been validated.
monitoring_trial.activation: Run the read-only reporter check first. Enable only with one exact paired reporter, fresh comparable system SOC/power and no second Home Battery for the same installation.
monitoring_trial.condition: Installation-flow and original control-setting conditions are unavailable during the monitoring reporter trial. Only fresh selected battery SOC and charging-state conditions are supported.

meter.title: Smart Meter readings
meter.help: Show the integration support report to refresh this local snapshot. The Smart Meter measures the grid; Home Battery measures battery charging and discharging. Keep one authoritative meter for each grid connection. If another device reports that same grid connection, review its Exclude from Energy setting to avoid duplicate grid accounting.
meter.refresh: Show the integration support report to see current meter evidence.
meter.none: No paired Smart Meter is present in this report.
meter.stale: Grid reading is stale or unavailable
meter.direct_help: Grid power comes from this meter's Developer MQTT feed. Phase readings have their own freshness limits.
meter.fallback_help: Grid power comes from the linked STREAM installation. This does not confirm a direct meter connection or fresh phase readings.
meter.missing_help: Check the meter's connection in EcoFlow, Developer API credentials and MQTT setting. Refresh this report after a new reading arrives; do not delete or re-pair the device just because data is missing.
meter.accounting: Energy totals remain calculated from observed grid power. Unseen gaps are not filled; native EcoFlow counters are not used.
meter.snapshot: This is a snapshot, not a live connection indicator. Refresh the report to check again.

support.check_scope: The optional reporter check reads EcoFlow's API for up to eight existing original Home Batteries. It does not change devices, controls, counters or grouping. A match does not verify installation-wide reporting.
support.instructions: For support: 1. Take an EcoFlow combined-battery screenshot with the individual battery watts visible. 2. Select Show integration support report, wait for completion, then Download integration JSON. Send the file privately with the screenshot, ideally captured within one minute. If downloading is difficult, send the screenshot first. When requested, also use Homey's Create diagnostic report and send its ID separately. Do not paste the JSON into that message box: Homey may truncate it. Nothing is sent automatically; check files and screenshots for private details before sharing.

errors.es22_wrong_driver: This STREAM 5000-series device was added in the wrong place. Enable STREAM 5000 beta pairing in the app settings, then delete this device and add it again as STREAM Home Battery (5000).
errors.developer_api_unsupported_device: This EcoFlow device is not supported through the Developer API. Delete it and add it again using its dedicated EcoFlow device type.

stream_5000_system.application_failed: Fresh EcoFlow readings could not be applied in Homey. Check the integration report.

stream_5000_unit.linked_power_unverified: Linked installation: individual battery power and direction are not verified. Use Home Battery for combined readings.
stream_5000_unit.reading_scope: Unit battery readings describe this physical device. House and grid readings describe the system and are not individual battery power. Blank unit flow/state means unverified, not zero. Grid meter and flow-derived import/export are separate sources. Use Home Battery for combined Energy.

stream_home_battery.title: Pair a STREAM Home Battery
stream_home_battery.intro: This represents one complete STREAM installation and provides whole-system totals for Homey Energy and widgets. Pair one per main system serial.

stream_unit.title: Pair a STREAM Unit
stream_unit.intro: This adds one inverter or battery as physical hardware. It does not provide whole-installation totals and is not used by Homey Energy or STREAM widgets. Pair STREAM Home Battery for the installation's combined energy data.

common.aggregate_required: Widgets use the complete installation, not a physical Unit.

battery_plan.title: Battery Plan
battery_plan.set_capacity: Set installed capacity in device settings
